propositions: Triaged 439 files in src/rebar to relocate comments violating taxonomy: history to tickets, architecture to ADRs, logic to code, contracts to schema, leaving only proximate just-in-time context inline.

Six subsystem shards identified and tagged ~2,033 recoverable comment lines across reconciler, plan_review+workflow, store/reducer, llm core, commands/CLI, and root/services; actual net recovery across all shards was ~85 lines (correction-and-relocation-dominated, not deletion-dominated).

Each shard produced a do_not_move list of load-bearing invariants (replay-compat, security constraints, API facts, anti-refactor warnings, linter pragmas) to be appended to .joe-janitor/tools.md before landing, protecting against future false-positive relocations.

Verified-stale comments were corrected in place where they document live invariants (e.g., P1-P9 floor vs actual P1-P11, Anthropic constraint stale rationale, inverted CLI flags); obsolete comments were deleted only after confirming no load-bearing content.

Nine proposed ADRs (0062–0069) consolidated arguments restated 4–8 times inline; relocated prose blocks were reduced to one-line citations after destination ADRs were committed, preserving full rationale without code clutter.
All six shards landed in dependency order (changes 1542–1547) with CI passing; no behaviour change, test suite and lint/typecheck targets verified unchanged across every shard.
